name: Ensurance Limited
summary: Ensurance Limited engages in the underwriting and sale of insurance products in Australia and the United Kingdom. The company provides contractors-all risk, contractors-plant and equipment, home build, combined liability, contractors assist, engineering inspection and insurance, construction, cyber, and terrorism and sabotage insurance products. It also offers underwriting services, including licensed builder annual construction, plant, and liability insurance; and licensed builder project specific construction insurance, trades liability, owner builder, and latent defect products. In addition, the company trades insurance products through online platform. Ensurance Limited is based in Bondi Junction, Australia.
